D4 · Warm Workroom · light first, dark twin

A well-run workshop: the numbers and the trail are always visible.

This is a static look; linked-screen prototypes come only for the directions you shortlist. The four screens and every word on them are the same as on the D1–D3 sheets (from docs/ux/02-concepts/LOOK_SHEET_COPY.md), so only the look changes. People's names and the board's numbers are synthetic. Nothing here is clickable.

SoftnessFirm: 6 px radius, ruled tables, no shadow
DensityDense: 36 px rows, compact stat tiles
ShapeTables, walnut-banded headers, vertical timeline, dark sidebar
TemperatureWarm: white canvas, walnut sidebar, terracotta
TypeSystem grotesk with tabular numbers

Four screens in light mode (the primary theme)

Desktop frames at 1200 px. On a narrow screen each frame scrolls sideways inside its own box; the page never does.

Palette (proposal; UX-3 makes it exact)

Seeds from DESIGN-DIRECTIONS.md (ground, panel, well, ink, ink2, primary, sidebar); the status, tag and sidebar-text tokens are added at the same temperature. Contrast is computed in Python from these hex values with the WCAG 2 formula; the build exits 1 and writes nothing if any text pair is under 4.5:1 or any UI edge under 3:1. Table rules (hair) are decorative; every control edge uses edge, which is checked. One added token was lifted to pass: the dark walnut band started at #3B2A22 (1.21:1 against the dark panel, so the banded header vanished) and is now #8E6250, same hue, 3.16:1. No seed hex from DESIGN-DIRECTIONS.md changed.
